summary: The PDF supports every participant count in the c101 form: 114 students were analyzed for design quality, 51 TRIZ-C and 63 TRIZ-C+LLM (GT 11 and 10, MB 10 and 10, WT 30 and 43; Table 2, p. 512), the counts are people (one rated solution per student, ANOVA error df 108 = 114 minus 6), and no page prints a count at assignment, so null n_randomized is right. The exclusions field correctly reports one GT student excluded for not understanding the problem (timing relative to assignment unstated) and one MB TRIZ-C+LLM student missing from the survey, no other study or paper is said to share these students, and S1 alone (114), or WT alone (73), meets the 50-person rule.
